note: Synthetic, invented OSINT-style content (fictional country 'Northland'). Not Gold Standard material. 'truth' blocks are this corpus's own labels; they are read only by the acceptance test, never by an input builder or prompt. 'model_output' blocks are scripted fake-model outputs replayed through the real pipeline; they include deliberately naive or over-eager outputs to exercise the deterministic guards.
